name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.common.ui.photo.crop.CropImageActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK opens this portrait screen when a photo needs to be selected or cropped. The user can adjust the crop and save the resulting image for the app to use.
disableEffect: Photo flows that require Yunxin cropping will not return a cropped image, so uploads that depend on that result can fail.
